actor: mk — solo gardener, tending the slowest layer: cards, doctrine, canon
trigger: A fast-layer finding deserves to sediment into doctrine; a card reaches confirmable state; or cross-garden discourse surfaces a contradiction that demands a ruling

steps.step: A card ripens: fields drafted by sessions, evidence cited against real paths (the card-lsp cite action), fractions visible on the walk
build_surface: card-check.py / card-lsp.py (shipped, incl. the cite action)

steps.step: mk ratifies: confirmation is a human-issued stamp; agents may never add evidence to confirmed fields or speak in mk's voice
build_surface: ratification flow surfaced in the HUD (new)

steps.step: The guests talk to each other: cross-garden discourse surfaces connections between cards — same person described twice, same pain clause, a decision echoing another garden's ruling — routed along the serving/layer structure
A cross-layer contradiction (fast probe vs slow doctrine) earns a popup-class interrupt; mk rules, and the ruling lands as a decision with rationale
The crystallized-understanding layer grows: what the factory next door cannot see accumulates as the estate's actual product
build_surface: cards + CanonGraph as the layer above the factory

mental_model: Garden salon, not factory: 'the guests talk to each other, sort of like the interconnection step that flux-melange is missing.' Cards are not documentation — they are crystallized understanding, the layer Gas Town's sharpest critique names as the factory's blind spot and the thing this estate is already building. Discourse between gardens is intelligence, not noise, but only because it is routed by structure (layers, serving edges) and classed by weight — a connection is a toast, a contradiction with doctrine is a popup. Ratification is mk's alone; the trace of governance is part of the work's form.

closed_decisions: The ratification signature is mk's alone — agent-added evidence to confirmed fields is laundering, and the tooling enforces it (finding-1)
Cards live on disk in the repos as the ledger of understanding; the HUD transcribes their state, never owns it
Cross-garden discourse is IN — mk ruled the guests talk to each other

closed_decisions.decision: A cross-layer contradiction is the interrupt class worth a popup; ordinary connections stay toast-class

The Autarch/garden-salon relationship: garden salon is the world (shared substrate where humans and agents grow projects), Autarch is the human's terminal-native interface into it — two clients of one substrate, superseding the a/b/c fork with a stronger (d). mk 2026-08-31: 'i think autarch is more like the interface for human users to be able to work in the garden salon on their projects.' Re-confirm at CUJ validation.

open_questions.question: Phasing of the salon substrate: which piece does Autarch read first (presence/participant state? proposals/annotations? the discourse layer?), and does 'garden salon' here mean the deployed Yjs/relay stack or the protocol/philosophy with a leaner local carrier? The walk's organs (briefing, waiting-on-me) must NOT gate on this — they ship against today's substrate (cards, tmux, CanonGraph) and migrate their data plane later.
Where does cross-garden discourse compute — a Pollard hunter, flux-melange gaining the interconnection step mk named, or a new door-side pass over cards?
What does a non-code garden's card look like? Roots are already plural; interests are wider than repos.

implied_features: Cross-garden discourse: connection/contradiction detection between cards, routed by the CanonGraph layer/serving structure
Card ratification state surfaced in the HUD (ripeness visible on the walk, stamp flow one keystroke away)
Popup-class delivery for cross-layer contradictions, toast-class for connections
flux-melange interconnection step (mk's own naming; lands in interflux, not Autarch — bead candidate)

reference_lineage.what_it_shaped: Trace-as-Form (ratification stamps), the intra-garden discourse model this journey extends inter-garden, and the open a/b/c fork
The 'layer above the factory' critique — the negative space this journey fills; Wasteland stamps rhyming with human-issued ratification
Delivery classes (B) applied to discourse output so guest-talk never becomes popup-spam
